title: The Link You Can Click
synopsis: Kit turns the preview path into a link you can Ctrl+click, then catches Tracetoon's own digest pulling in old prompts and another repo's tests, and fixes all three.
altText: Panel 1: Sam squints at a relative preview path that won't open. Panel 2: Kit prints a full file link and Sam clicks it. Panel 3: Glitch stuffs old prompts and another repo's test results into the PR's digest. Panel 4: Kit shows a clean digest with only this PR's work and 57 of 57 checks passing.

panels.scene: Sam stares at a terminal showing a relative path to preview.html that can't be clicked.

dialogue.speaker: sam
dialogue.text: Where do I even open this?

dialogue.speaker: kit
dialogue.text: That path only makes sense to me.

panels.scene: Kit prints a full file:/// link and Sam Ctrl+clicks it, opening the preview.

dialogue.speaker: kit
dialogue.text: Now it's a real link. Ctrl+click!

panels.scene: Glitch sneaks old prompts and another repo's test results into this PR's digest.

dialogue.speaker: glitch
dialogue.text: Old prompts! Someone else's tests! All yours!

panels.scene: Kit presents a clean digest with only this PR's work and a 57 of 57 score.

dialogue.speaker: kit
dialogue.text: Only this PR's work now. 57 of 57.
